text: Siddharth starts at the new agency Monday. Bit nervous about the commute, it's two trains now.
dana's leaving do is friday at the plough. collection going round, chip in a tenner
Mai mentioned her brother Theo just got promoted to shift manager at the depot. She's dead proud of him.
Eli 40 next Thurs!! he's into vinyl, specifically old jazz pressings. look in the record shop on Church St
Note to self: Ivan's last day before he retires is end of the month. Thirty-one years at the firm. Need to sign the card that's in Heather's drawer.
Jakub said his manager keeps moving his deadlines around and he's had enough. Looking at other jobs quietly. Check in with him sometime next week.

so um Heather was telling me at lunch that her daughter starts at the nursery in early March and she's already dreading the drop off, like she was properly welling up about it, and her husband can't do mornings because of his shifts so it's all on her. I said I'd cover her nine o'clocks for the first week if it comes to that.
Andile - interview w/ the Leeds office Weds. Wants to move up north to be nearer his parents.
Kieran Morris, "Kez" to everyone on the team, got the senior role. Announced this morning. Send congrats.
Rohan bday sat. likes climbing, has been eyeing a new chalk bag. maybe that + a card
Henrik and his wife are off to Lisbon for their anniversary in a fortnight. Ask him for the restaurant name after, wants to recommend it
Mehmet's dad has his knee op tomorrow. He's taking the whole week off. Text him Thursday to see how it went.
Client call with Haruto Sato went fine. He's moving to the Osaka office over the summer, so we'll get someone new on the account.
Andre's party is off, his flat flooded. Doing drinks at mine instead on Saturday.
Afua passed her probation!! Was so worried about it for weeks. Take her for a coffee to celebrate
Bridget's cat Pickles has to go to the vet Monday for a tooth out. She's in bits about it.
pick up dry cleaning, renew parking permit before Friday
Ravi said Sana's due in January. They've not picked names yet. He's terrified and excited in equal measure lol
Joanna's brother Pedro is getting married in Seville next June, she's doing a reading. Already practising.
Mandla is coeliac, remember for the team lunch next Tuesday. Book somewhere that does proper gf.
Alfie's 18th is this weekend. His mum said he's saving for driving lessons so cash or a voucher would go down well
Alejandro got made redundant yesterday. Didn't see it coming at all. Call him tonight, don't just text.
Meera's started a pottery course on Tuesday evenings, loving it. Wants a wheel of her own one day.

Aleksander was on the phone with me for ages about his first week at the bank. Hates the open plan, likes his team though. His boss sounds intense. Probation review is end of November. Remember to ask how the review went in December. He also said Meera from HR has been really helpful.
Valentina's moving to Dublin early next year for the new role. Her partner Tadhg is from there so his family are thrilled.
Colm - grumpy re: restructure. thinks his team gets merged w/ Dana's after Xmas
theo's leaving drinks thurs 6ish, tapas place. I'm going straight from the dentist
Jonah has his driving test next Friday, third attempt. He's really anxious. Text him good luck Thursday night and then ask how it went on the Friday.

Siddharth's wife Meera is turning 35 on the 14th and he's planning a surprise meal. He asked me to keep the Saturday free and to help him book somewhere. She loves Lebanese food apparently. Ring him back tomorrow lunchtime with a couple of options. Also she hates surprises a bit, so maybe keep it small.

Had a long catch up with Heather Khan about the client from hell. They want the whole deck redone by Monday. She's working the weekend again, not ok. Her manager Dana isn't backing her up either. Should message her Sunday night to see how she's holding up before the client meeting.
Mai's birthday was last Tuesday and I completely forgot. Get her something small this week, she mentioned wanting that orange candle from the market.
Ivan's retirement lunch got cancelled, his wife's in hospital. Ask Bridget if there's a card going round for him.
Eli says his son Jonah got into Manchester for engineering. Starts in September. Eli's gutted he's moving away but thrilled.
I'm running the onboarding session for the new starters on Wednesday afternoon. Need to update the slides by Tuesday.
Andile's girlfriend is doing her first half marathon Sunday. He's going to hold a sign lol
Kieran says the regional director is leaving end of Q4 and the rumours are he's in the running. Don't mention it to anyone.
dana mentioned her mum's 70th is next month, big family do in Cork. she's flying over the Thurs before

voice note. right so Rohan rang, he's had the offer from the consultancy, it's more money but way longer hours and he's got the little one now so he's torn. Wants to talk it through properly over a pint sometime this weekend, maybe Sunday afternoon. Must remember to bring up the parental leave thing because that's what he's actually worried about.
Henrik is vegetarian, doesn't drink. Into cycling, rides to work every day from Clapham.
Haruto's daughter has her piano recital tomorrow evening, he's leaving early for it
Afua's sister Bridget had the baby! little boy, Kwame. Send flowers to Afua to pass on
Mehmet's into F1 big time, Ferrari fan. Good for Secret Santa.

Andre starts at Google next month, finally. Was out of work since spring and really struggling, so this is huge. He said he spent most of the summer applying and hearing nothing back, and his partner was carrying everything. First day's the 3rd. Must send him something nice for his first day.
Reminder: get Valentina a leaving gift. She's into houseplants and cooking. Card's going round Weds, drinks are Friday.
book car in for MOT, sometime next week. Tues or Weds ideally
joanna and pedro both having a rough time, pedro's dad passed on Sunday. funeral is end of next week. check in with joanna over the weekend
Alfie Gupta from accounts is off on paternity leave from tomorrow. Twins! Pop a card on his desk this morning.
Jakub's dog Bruno went missing last night. Found by a neighbour this morning thank god. Jakub's still shaky.
Colm's wife Sana is doing her PhD viva in early December. He says she's barely sleeping. Ask him how it went after.

Mandla got the promotion to team lead, starts properly on the 1st. He wants to do a team dinner sometime end of the month. Offer to organise it, he's rubbish with bookings. Apparently Mandla's wife Afua is chuffed to bits, they're going away for a long weekend to celebrate early November.
Meeting with Popescu (client) moved to next Thursday 10am. Tell Siddharth.

Ravi's boss Mrs Dubois retires at Easter and he's applying for her job. He said it's a long shot and he's quite nervous about the interview panel, which is apparently sometime in late February. I said I'd do a mock interview with him the week before, so remind me to block out an evening. He's also into his running, training for the Brighton marathon in April, so he's got a lot on.
Pedro loves anything Arsenal and those weird hot sauces. bday in early Feb
Tadhg Usman just started on my team today. Quiet but sharp. Ex-teacher, retrained in data.

Heather mentioned her son Alejandro is off to uni in Glasgow in a fortnight. She's going to miss him loads. Alejandro is nervous about living away from home, he's never even done a sleepover. Heather's planning to drive him up herself on the Saturday.
Dentist Thursday 4pm. Gym before work tomorrow.
Theo said his partner Valentina finally got the job at the museum. She starts after half term. They're celebrating with dinner at the new Thai place on Friday.
Jonah's mum (Mrs Khan) told me he's struggling with his new manager, really micromanaging. Has a one-to-one about it on Monday. Follow up with Jonah after that.
Aleksander + Meera got engaged at the weekend!! wedding probably summer 2028. congrats card from the team

Eli was saying his boss Henrik keeps asking him to cover the Bristol clients. He doesn't mind the travel but wants a pay rise to match. Has his review on Wednesday. Henrik's apparently against it because of budget. If it goes badly Eli says he'll start looking around in the new year. Ask him Thursday how it went.
